description:
Configure, inspect, activate, or incrementally nudge multi-attribute utility weight profiles (actions: configure, get, list, activate, nudge). Use set_utility_weights instead of evaluate_situation when defining decision preferences (aggression, caution, greed, exploration) rather than evaluating actions.

Returns configured utility profile, active weight map, or profile directory.

action.description: Profile operation: configure, get, list, activate, nudge

delta.description: Key-value map of weight deltas for nudge action

is_active.description: Whether to set as currently active profile

weights.description: Key-value map of weight values (0.0 to 1.0)

name: set_utility_weights
